key_insight: ProIQA assesses math item quality by combining the problem stem with the generated solution process, so it can judge pedagogical value more finely than stem-only checks.
engineering_relevance: It offers a scalable way to filter and validate automatically generated math items for intelligent tutoring and personalized education systems.
method: Formulates item quality assessment across knowledge concepts, difficulty, and disciplinary competencies in a process-aware framework.
Builds structured reasoning trees from raw solutions using large language models.
Encodes tree topology with GNNs and fuses it with stem semantics in a dual-view “Stem + Solving” architecture.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports extensive experiments on K12 math datasets, showing ProIQA captures process-oriented features for evaluating AIG outputs.
watch_item: The approach depends on accurate reasoning-tree construction from solutions, so errors from the LLM or graph encoding could affect assessment reliability.
paper_title: ProIQA: A Process-Based Framework for Fine-Grained Math Item Quality Assessment
